note: Captured 2026-10-28 with headless Chrome. E-mail addresses, phone numbers and the publisher postal address were replaced by bullets before capture. The website is a stock WordPress "Newspaper" theme credited "by Haek" in its footer: it is context for the magazine, not Pau's design. Desktop images are 1440px wide (1x), chunk height <= 2000; mobile images are 780px wide (390 css px at 2x).
